language.description: Locale code for UI text (e.g., en, de, fr)

char_sets.description: List of character sets to include in the input pad

char_sets.items.description: Definition of a single character set (flat structure for schema definition only; rendered via loop in template if supported, otherwise flattened in sample_values context if needed. However, strict Jinja2 list of maps is standard). NOTE: Since output format requires flat items for schema, we define the structure here for validation purposes, but the template iterates over the list directly.
